changelog:
- Fixed Fokk Mesh Offline Bug (v3.1): Bound local tunnel ServerSocket immediately (<2ms), switched manifest loading to parallel racing across all live feeds (no sequential 404 cold-start stalls), raised global mobile timeouts (5.5s-6s), and added Happy-Eyeballs parallel relay racing so pages load fast from any region.
- Live Verified Relay Manifest: Pruned 9 dead/refused relays and verified 8 live relays + 4 true 2-hop ingress chains.
- Authenticated & ISP-Encrypted Relay Support: Added full SOCKS5 RFC 1929 username/password auth, HTTP Basic auth, and TLS-over-SOCKS5 (strict HTTPS SNI verification) across Android, Desktop, Sentinel scanner, and deploy_fokk_node.sh (stunnel4 + Let's Encrypt).
- CI Release Promotion Fix: Automatically promotes prereleases to Latest on main with 3-attempt retry on transient GitHub API errors.
